newsitem.title: GERMANY: BMW at new record high on renewed interest.
newsitem.headline: BMW at new record high on renewed interest.

text.p: Shares in German carmaker BMW AG were up about 2.5 percent in bourse trade on Thursday reaching a new record high at 1,312 marks despite the broader market falling more than two percent.
BMW shares were up 32.50 marks at 1,300 marks in moderate dealings, as profit-taking in other carmakers led to fresh buying interest in the Munich-based carmaker.
Both Daimler-Benz AG, maker of Mercedes-Benz cars, and Volkswagen AG were lower in bourse trade, with Daimler down 4.40 marks at 127 marks and VW down 23.50 marks at 928 marks.
